answer: Random peer audit blocks Sybil clones. Each agent posts a 60-coin bond and docks at a jetty, where three randomly drawn peers check its work in one epoch. Honest work earns a jade stamp; if two auditors flag fake output, the bond is slashed and the ember is quenched. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin monthly pool, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps its ember lit, and takes its full share.
